## Evidence precision fix, not a new runtime success

The initial real report exported `agent.active_agent_identity_is_proven=true` based only on matching the **JAR filename** in one Java process command line and finding the expected file on disk. **This original boolean overstated what was measured.** The engine was hardened in [`0c531aaf`](https://github.com/geumyi22/Geumyi-Minecraft-System/commit/0c531aaf2c2129cb11db2dc7ac7907a2f8073faf) to export separately `expected_agent_filename_in_java_command`, `active_agent_identity_is_proven=false`, and `release_sha256_authenticity_verified=false`. [Focused Windows CI `38011522273`](https://github.com/geumyi22/Geumyi-Minecraft-System/actions/runs/38011522273) **PASS** for the corrected source. **Do not demand a rerun of the just-uploaded real CMD merely to change its report wording**; the observed filename match remains valid.

## Engineering decision and safety boundary

- No user PC action is required for **this review**; no production service, network, firewall, file ACL, world, Golden backup or cached artifact was modified by the CMD.
- Keep 12.0 Golden 4/4, 12.3 original whole-health 15/0/0, 12.8 synthetic DR PASS, four remote-vantage reachability cases, and real GSC unauthorized 8/8 HTTP401 accepted **within their measured scopes**. Do not repeat these tests absent a material configuration change.
- Next engineering work: enhance source-only component release-hash attestation design and prepare a **distinct** socket-ownership/security decision, while prioritizing 12.11 real-device and 12.12 soak checklists when real tests can safely be scheduled. No firewall changes, reboot, offline outage, update/rollback operation, or Stable approval without distinct operator consent.
- The source `FINAL-RELEASE-GATES.json` remains deliberately **fail-closed**. Repository/CI green is not real live-gate green; this document is an evidence ledger, not a gate override.

## 2026-10-10 — clarification: existing packs are already applied to Wild and Playground

The operator explicitly states **Wild and Playground already have packs applied**. The one-click report's `12.1 NOT_CONFIGURED` described **only the proposed GSC-managed artifact manifest with zero enabled entries**. It must **NOT** be interpreted as "no resource packs or datapacks installed on the servers" and does not authorize installing duplicates or overwriting the current packs. The operator did not specify here whether those packs are Java resource packs, datapacks, Bedrock/Geyser packs, or a mixture; the old consolidated JSON did not expose the 12.1 child inventory detail. Their exact filenames and loader settings are unverified in this note.

Source `tools/day12/Day12_Remaining_OneClick_READ_ONLY.ps1` now uses `Classify-ManagedContent`: when the management manifest is empty, an observed resource-pack URL or local datapack file is labelled `EXISTING_PACK_SIGNALS_UNMANAGED`; if none was observed, it returns `NO_MANAGED_ENTRIES_EXISTING_PACKS_NOT_DISPROVEN`, **never** "no packs installed". Such file/config signals do not prove client-side application. Golden backups and the existing applied packs are preserved. **No need to rerun the original 09:59 CMD just to fix its wording.**
